watch_list.summary: The official docs at https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot got a visual refresh, plus Copy for LLM and View as Markdown so you can paste a page straight into a bot.

trendy.short_title: Laya to cut Grok Bot token spend
trendy.summary: Install Laya, a small local classifier, on the bot's cloud computer so triage, retries, and yes/no gates skip the paid model; keep it in shadow mode for a day before it starts enforcing.

trendy.short_title: Pages as a live HQ, dashboard, and guides
trendy.summary: Have your bots publish finished work as live Pages instead of leaving it in chat; he shows a 14-bot office HQ, a custom analytics dashboard, and interactive learning guides.
A checked list of ten repos with real install paths, including Grok Build, the Claude Code review plugin, grok-skills, an iMessage skill for Mac, and the awesome-grok-bot and plugins catalogs.

trendy.short_title: Grok Bot and Claude on a shared 24/7 loop
trendy.summary: Connect Grok Bot and Claude through webhooks and Notion, and keep a shared project brain on GitHub, so they pass work to each other around the clock without you prompting each step.

trendy.short_title: Grok Bot driving local ComfyUI video
trendy.summary: Point Grok Bot at a local ComfyUI workflow on your GPU (he used H3ZEROSTUDIO on a 5060 Ti) and describe the scenes; it produced a two-part 20-second clip from one prompt.
